title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
role: Shows that training a new encoder against only a frozen hub (image) inherits the hub's alignment to text; the template for adding score paths as a third space by matching them to one frozen partner.
reads: Clean inputs only: frozen OpenCLIP ViT-H images and text, plus trainable encoders for 2 s audio mel-spectrograms, depth as disparity, thermal images and 6x2000 IMU, each through a linear head to a normalized embedding; no diffusion inputs.
trains: Audio, depth, thermal and IMU encoders with symmetric InfoNCE against the frozen image encoder on naturally co-occurring pairs (2M AudioSet videos, ~5K SUN RGB-D, 12,025 LLVIP, 510,142 Ego4D clips), in-batch negatives, fixed temperature, image and text encoders frozen.
combines: No noise predictions; embeddings compared by cosine after temperature scaling, and summed for arithmetic as 0.5 times each L2-normalized embedding (0.95 video + 0.05 audio for retrieval).
adding: Claimed to compose semantics, shown only with qualitative retrievals (Figure 4); one quantitative weighted sum lifts MSR-VTT R@1 from 36.1% to 36.8%; no stated condition, no failure cases.
noise_and_seed: not addressed; no seeds or error bars, ESC is a 5-fold mean and few-shot runs fix the same k samples for all methods.
unseen: partly; (modality, text) pairs are never trained on and evaluation labels are unused, but concepts are not held out from the frozen OpenCLIP text side; no two-object, relation, counting or binding test.
headline: Emergent zero-shot ESC-50 top-1 accuracy 66.9% against 68.6% for AudioCLIP (trained on AudioSet class names); Clotho text-to-audio Recall@1 6.0% against 3.0% for AVFIC; ImageBind ViT-H with frozen OpenCLIP.
suggests: (inferred) Freeze a text-and-latent pair and train only a score-path encoder against the noisy latent of the same canvas, seed and step, using the small-data settings (fixed temperature, linear head, batch ~512, spatially aligned crops); report sum-lands-on-joint as a rate with a random-pair control, which ImageBind never gives.
model: OpenCLIP ViT-H image and text encoders (frozen) with ViT audio, depth and thermal encoders and a transformer IMU encoder; reimplemented DALLE-2 decoder for audio-to-image
